subtitle.zh: 从真空能级、费米能级到 Vth 与金属栅选择
subtitle.en: From vacuum and Fermi levels to Vth and metal-gate selection

heading.zh: 01 核心定义与 02 半导体差异

body.zh: 真空能级减费米能级才是功函数：Φ = E_vac − E_F。电子逸出需要克服功函数。掺杂、表面态和能带弯曲都会改变测得值；图中对比 n 型、本征、p 型，并标注 E_C、E_F、E_V。
body.en: Work function is vacuum level minus Fermi level: Φ = E_vac − E_F. Electron emission must overcome this energy. Doping, surface states, and band bending affect measured values; the diagrams compare n-type, intrinsic, and p-type materials with E_C, E_F, E_V labels.

heading.zh: 03 接触机制与 04 栅极作用

body.zh: 接触前金属与半导体各有费米能级；接触后费米能级对齐，界面重新分配电荷。有效功函数通过平带电压参与调节 Vth。栅结构为金属栅（功函数 Φ_M）/High-k/Si，配有 C–V 与 I_d–V_g 曲线，后者标出 Vth 及 10⁻³、10⁻⁶、10⁻⁹ 电流刻度。
body.en: Before contact, metal and semiconductor have separate Fermi levels; after contact, Fermi levels align and interface charge redistributes. Effective work function contributes to Vth through flat-band voltage. The illustrated gate is metal (Φ_M)/high-k/Si, with C–V and I_d–V_g curves; the latter marks Vth and current ticks 10⁻³, 10⁻⁶, 10⁻⁹.

heading.zh: 05 工艺调控与 06 异常诊断

body.zh: 材料、界面偶极、厚度和热预算共同塑造 EWF。堆栈从上到下为填充金属、功函数金属（WFM）、界面偶极层、高介电常数层（High-k）、硅衬底。
body.en: Materials, interface dipoles, thickness, and thermal budget jointly shape EWF. From top to bottom: fill metal, work-function metal (WFM), interface-dipole layer, high-k layer, silicon substrate.

body.zh: Vth 漂移要区分栅堆栈（功函数/界面）、介质（电荷/陷阱）与沟道（掺杂/应力）的贡献。图中以初始与漂移后直方图、晶圆 Vth 热图（红色高、蓝色低）展示分布。
body.en: Vth drift requires separating gate-stack (work function/interface), dielectric (charge/traps), and channel (doping/stress) contributions. Initial and shifted histograms and a wafer Vth heatmap (red high, blue low) illustrate the distributions.

heading.zh: 07 整合权衡与 08 工艺选择

body.zh: Vth、变异性、可靠性和填充能力一起优化；图中给出 GAA 栅槽填充示意。先判断控制的是表面、接触还是栅堆栈。
body.en: Optimize Vth, variability, reliability, and fill capability together; a GAA gate-trench fill schematic illustrates the trade-off. First decide whether the target is a surface, contact, or gate stack.

body.zh: 表面表征：表面能级、表面态密度、能带弯曲。接触工程：界面电荷、接触势垒、费米能级钉扎。MOS 栅堆栈：金属栅功函数、介质厚度与质量、界面偶极工程。
body.en: Surface characterization: surface energy levels, surface-state density, band bending. Contact engineering: interface charge, contact barrier, Fermi-level pinning. MOS gate stack: metal-gate work function, dielectric thickness/quality, and interface-dipole engineering.

uncertain: 页末水印与实质文字或图示区域重叠；figureCrop保留完整图表，未猜测补画遮挡区域。
